data.title: 樱岛麻衣 · 兔耳幻象褪去的清晨
data.action: 站在透光的落地窗前，一手拿着马克杯啜饮黑咖啡，一手撩起披肩的黑长发，修长双腿在晨光下泛着瓷白光泽，回眸微嗔含笑。
data.location: 海景高层公寓客厅，阳台外是晨曦下蔚蓝的江之岛海平线
data.lighting: 初升红日从海平面洒入室内，金橙色的漫射光在发丝边缘晕染出梦幻光芒
data.mood: 国民女演员在心上人面前卸下防备的成熟纯真，从容而深情
data.description: 海景高层公寓客厅，阳台外是晨曦下蔚蓝的江之岛海平线。站在透光的落地窗前，一手拿着马克杯啜饮黑咖啡，一手撩起披肩的黑长发，修长双腿在晨光下泛着瓷白光泽，回眸微嗔含笑。 她微微抬眸轻语——“咲太，看呆了吗？今天可没有兔女郎套装……不过如果只是你看的话，这样也可以哦。”
data.promptProse: Standing barefoot beside the floor-to-ceiling glass window of a high-rise oceanfront apartment at early dawn, Mai wears an inky-black watered-silk slip dress with thin straps and a high side slit. Holding a ceramic coffee mug in one hand and sweeping back her long hair with the other, she glances over her shoulder with a poised, teasing smile while the Enoshima horizon stretches outside. Warm orange sunrise backlighting rims her silhouette and gleams along the black silk.
data.animaCaption: Standing beside the sunlit floor-to-ceiling apartment window in a high-slit black silk slip dress, Mai holds a coffee mug while brushing back her hair with a poised, teasing glance. Warm golden sunrise over the ocean backlights her silhouette.
data.nsfwProse: She wears an inky-black watered-silk slip dress with ultra-thin straps and a high thigh side slit that frames her slender bare legs.
